<!-- pr-reviewer: 820245b9b1ffc0653ce82200e58e22f93d736d0f -->
**Needs changes before merge.**

Review of the diff against the stack base `498ba08b5` (PR #2312). The branch already contains `origin/main` `3f41b8da6`: the trial merge is "Already up to date". Build and tests ran locally, in a worktree of this review.

### What looks good

- The fix closes the reported gouge. On the base, the probe "stock-source Deburr, box stock, part 'other' at x 30..35" posts. On this head, the post is refused.
- The live re-judge names a part that is added after generation: `post blocked - S1 now cuts part 'other' (move 5 cuts past the finish surface) - ...`. This also works on a from-model stock for a second part (probe below).
- `stock_part_of` is the strict reading: same stock kind, judged source, same facet count, each vertex within 1e-6. All reads that fail give `None` (no exemption).
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in `src`. All files are under 400 lines. The test file has a provenance line and a Gate map. The body has `Changelog:`, "stacked on #2312" and `Fixes #2313`. The decision entry is present.

### Results (locally, `-p camcraft-app`, debug, `--test-threads=6`)

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `stock_deburr_part` | 4 passed |
| `stock_chamfer_added_part` | 3 passed |
| `edge_break_gate` | 5 passed |
| `edge_break_bound` | 5 passed |
| `stock_source_holes` | 9 passed |
| `keep_law` | 31 passed |
| `kept_parts_live` | 4 passed |
| `post_not_judged` | 4 passed |
| `deburr_links` | 1 passed |
| `edge_volume_bound` | 2 passed |
| `setup_carry_credits` | 7 passed |
| `golden_cl` | 33 passed |
| `operations` (filter `deburr`) | 5 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

### Probes of the exception (local test file, not pushed)

| Probe | Result | Correct? |
|---|---|---|
| From-model stock on "part", stock moved 0.5 mm in X | refused: sim gouge, 0.81 mm into 'part' | yes |
| From-model stock moved 1e-7 mm | posts | yes (inside the 1e-6 tolerance, no real cut) |
| From-model stock moved 2 mm after generation | refused: `S1: inputs moved since generation - regenerate before posting` | yes |
| From-model stock = "part", second part "other" at the edge, known at generation | refused: `S1: move 5 cuts past the finish surface` | yes, but the part is not named |
| Same, "other" (0.3 mm sliver) added after generation | refused: `S1 now cuts part 'other' ...` | yes |
| From-model stock, 5 mm break width, part source and stock source | both post | yes: the stock source gets no more than the part source |
| Box stock, part known at generation (the issue's case) | refused: `post blocked - gouge: program cuts below the model in 81 cell(s), worst 0.94 mm at (34.94, -4.81, z 19.06)` | refused, but see request 2 |
| Box stock with the same size as the part (30 x 30 x 20), stock-source Deburr | base: posts. This head: refused with `post blocked - gouge: program cuts below the model in 924 cell(s), worst 0.81 mm ...` | stricter case; see request 2 |

### Mutations (each restored after the run)

| Mutation | Pinning tests |
|---|---|
| Remove `Deburr` from `is_stock_kept_kind` | 2 fail |
| `breaks_stock_edge` for Chamfer only | 1 fails |
| `stock_part_of` always `None` | 1 fails |
| `kept_models` spares no part | 1 fails |
| `parts_in_stock` spared branch removed | 1 fails |
| **`stock_part_of` skips the facet test (`Some(source)` for each from-model stock)** | **all 4 pass** |

### Requested before merge

1. **Pin the facet test of the exception.** `crates/app/src/stock_sim_breaks.rs:71-77` is the guard that makes the exception safe. A mutation that removes it passes all 4 tests. With that mutation, the probe "from-model stock moved 0.5 mm" posts a 0.81 mm gouge into 'part'. Add a test: a from-model stock that is moved off its source part (for example 0.5 mm in X), a stock-source Deburr, and the post is refused. Aligned and quarter turn, as in the other tests. A second case is useful: a source that is marked raw stock only, or a fixture.
2. **The refusal does not name the part or the way out (issue "Done means").** The issue asks: "the refusal names the operation and the part". In the issue's case (part known at generation, box stock), the post line is only the sim's located gouge. It names neither `S1` nor 'other'. The op warning is a plain `Gouge` ("move 3 cuts past the finish surface"). The PR body says this, but it does not meet the issue. The same text refuses the stricter case: a box stock of the same size as the part breaks the part's own edges, posted on the base, and is now refused with no op name, no part name and no way out. The fix is small:
   - Extend `note_stock_chamfer_gouges` (`crates/app/src/operation/keep_law.rs:295-307`) to `Deburr`, with Deburr wording ("stock-source deburr breaks into a part; deburr with the part as source"). This can be a second variant or a kind field. The live re-judge text in `kept_rejudge.rs:115-116` must follow.
   - If possible, name the part in the generation warning. Otherwise record in the decision that the op name and the way out are the agreed form, and say this on #2313.
   - Make `a_stock_source_deburr_into_a_part_known_at_generation_never_posts` assert the op name and the way-out text, not only the sim's gouge line.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)

- When the stock IS the part, `breaks_stock_edge` keeps the #303 credit over the columns of all parts, not only the source part. Today the solid law (generation) and the live re-judge (post) catch a cut into a second part (probes above). The sim is not a second net for that part. A note in the decision is enough.
- The 1e-6 vertex test depends on the facet order of the stock copy. `SetStock` and `update_model` copy the facets in order, so this is correct now. A future re-mesh of the stock copy would silently remove the exemption (stricter, so safe).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 4146fbba6cb092d0b49e9adb605af46a829c7060 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

This is a re-review of the delta `820245b9b..4146fbba6`, merged with `main` (`3c7385fba`). The two requests of the last review are done.

### What looks good
- Request 1 (pin the facet check) is done. The new test `a_from_model_stock_moved_off_its_part_is_not_the_part` puts the from-model stock 0.5 mm off the part. It does this for the aligned stock and for the stock turned a quarter turn. The test asserts that the post is refused.
- Request 2 (name the op, the part and the way out) is done. `note_stock_chamfer_gouges` now changes the Deburr's `Gouge` into `Warning::StockDeburrGouge`. On a refused post, `posting_sim::stock_edge_named` adds "S1 breaks into part 'other' (... use the part as source)".
- The new variant blocks the post. `Warning::blocks_post()` excludes only `Scallop`, `ProbeSearch` and `SinkerFinishOrder`. Each match that names `StockChamferGouge` now also names `StockDeburrGouge`:
  - `mcp/job.rs` maps it to "gouge".
  - `warned_moves.rs` includes it.
  - `ui/src/operations.rs` gives it the same severity and the same blocking flag as the chamfer variant.
- The naming step cannot remove a refusal. It runs only in the arm where the sim found gouge cells. That arm sets `problem` before the step runs, and the step only adds text to it. It has no `unwrap`. A missing op, toolpath or operation gives `None` through `?`. A job that cannot be read gives a text that the post shows. A missing named finding falls back to `"{name}: {w}"`.
- The decision file now records the refusal text and the remaining limits.

### Results (merged with main, locally)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app --test stock_deburr_part` | 5 passed |
| `stock_chamfer_added_part` | 3 passed |
| `keep_law` | 31 passed |
| `kept_parts_live` | 4 passed |
| `edge_break_gate` | 5 passed |
| `edge_break_bound` | 5 passed |
| `post_not_judged` | 4 passed |
| `stock_source_holes` | 9 passed |
| `golden_cl` | 33 passed |
| `camcraft-sim --lib` | 184 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib warn` (from `crates/ui`) | 14 passed |
| clippy `-p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

Mutation check: I changed `stock_part_of` in `crates/app/src/stock_sim_breaks.rs:77` to skip the facet test (`let _ = same; Some(source)`). With that change, this test fails:
```
test a_from_model_stock_moved_off_its_part_is_not_the_part ... FAILED
test result: FAILED. 4 passed; 1 failed
```
At the last review, the same mutation passed all tests. I reverted the change after the run.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
- `crates/sim/src/verify/types.rs` is now 422 lines (it was 416). This is more than the 400-line rule. A split of the `Warning` text into its own file is a possible follow-up.
- `crates/ui/src/operations.rs` was 608 lines before this PR. The PR adds 1 line.
- The PR does not touch process files, dependencies, build scripts, snapshot PNGs or `CHANGELOG.md`. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #2313`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
